function.name: Open
function.desc: shows the dialog with the current name prefilled

param.name: currentName
param.desc: name the load list shows for this save right now

param.name: canReset
param.desc: 1 when the save carries a stashed original name

function.name: SetLabels
function.desc: the captions, already translated: the movie cannot reach the localization tables, and a key assigned to a text field from ActionScript is not resolved on the way in

param.name: hint
param.desc: word beside the F2 key over the save list

function.name: ShowHint
function.desc: shows or hides the F2 prompt drawn over the save list

param.name: visible
param.desc: 1 to put the prompt on screen, 0 to take it off

function.name: SetInput
function.desc: key feed from the plugin's input listener: the engine delivers typed characters to the movie but not Enter or Esc

event.name: OnReset
event.desc: the player asked for the original name back

param.name: TriggerName
param.desc: name of the global audio trigger to play

function.name: SetLabels
function.desc: the captions, already translated: as on the SavegameRenamer element above

param.name: hint
param.desc: word beside the F2 key over the save list

function.name: ShowHint
function.desc: shows or hides the F2 prompt

param.name: visible
param.desc: 1 to put the prompt on screen, 0 to take it off
